title: Bibliographic Integrity Signal
description: Canonical, versioned carrier for bibliographic integrity observations. A signal records what was checked and observed; terminality remains an explicit policy decision owned by the citation finalizer.

marker_token.description: Always null in v1.0, v1.1, and v1.2. Existing CONTAMINATED-* projection remains owned by the legacy contamination carrier during migration; new signal types never mint a second marker advisory token.

allOf.description: A tortured-phrase list match is mechanically reproducible but remains an advisory risk marker. It can never be relabeled as a factual origin finding or promoted into terminal policy.
